contentEditor.spikeDescription: Synthetic examples. Changes stay in this session and are not saved to a server; reloading discards them.
contentEditor.sessionOnly: Kept in this prototype session only
contentEditor.previewHelp: The preview uses a renderer independent of the editor.
contentEditor.pasteDescription: Review the content below before inserting it at the selected position. Supported formatting is retained; fonts, sizes, colors and spacing follow the test layout.
contentEditor.pasteStale: The content changed during preview. Paste again at the intended position; your current edits are unchanged.

groups.independentHint: Questions in this group share their materials. Copies in the bank or another test are edited independently.
groups.instructionsHint: Instructions for the whole group, shown before its materials.
groups.removeMaterialBody: This material and its gap links will be removed. Questions and library files will be retained.
groups.removeQuestionBody: This question and its answers will be removed from this group. Independent copies and published tests will remain unchanged.
groups.removeBoundHint: This question is linked from shared material. Remove or change its material gap links before deleting the question.
groups.selectContent: Select a material or question to edit.
groups.assetHint: Choose a library file or upload a new one.
groups.assetLabelHint: Learners see this label; keep it short and descriptive.
groups.imageLimit: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
groups.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Please retry.
groups.linkHint: Select text to add or edit a link.
groups.linkHTTPS: Only HTTPS addresses are supported. Links do not open while editing.
groups.selectionChanged: The content changed. Close the dialog and select the insertion point again.
groups.sharedPolicyHint: The allowance is shared across this group and survives learner navigation and reloads.
groups.gapHint: Link every gap to a choice question or a specific answer blank. Each target can be linked once.
groups.chooseTarget: Choose a question or answer blank
groups.titleRequired: Enter a group name between 1 and 200 characters.
groups.limitExceeded: This group exceeds the content limits. Split it into smaller groups.
groups.invalidQuestion: Check the question content and answers.
groups.materialTitleRequired: Enter a material name between 1 and 200 characters.
groups.unboundGaps: Link every gap to an existing question or answer blank.
groups.duplicateTarget: A question or answer blank is linked more than once.
groups.choiceTargetRequired: A choice gap must link to a choice question.
groups.loadFailed: Could not load the question group. Please retry.
groups.recoveryTitle: Unsynced edits are available on this device
groups.recoveryBody: Drafts are kept for your account for up to 7 days. Restore to review and continue editing, or discard to use the server version.
groups.discardDraft: Discard draft and use server version
groups.localUnavailable: Unsynced · Local recovery is unavailable. Save to the server before closing.
groups.saveFailed: Could not save. Your edits remain on screen; please retry.
groups.localSaved: Unsynced · Draft saved on this device
groups.conflictBody: Your edits are preserved. Continue editing and save as a new bank group; the current server version will remain unchanged.
groups.archivedHint: This group is archived. Restore it from the list before editing.
groups.leaveBody: Save to the server before leaving, or keep a local draft to recover later.
groups.bankHint: Keep passages, recordings and their questions together. Each use in a test creates an independent copy.
groups.search: Search group titles or question text…
groups.archiveBody: Archive these groups from the active list. Test copies and published versions remain unchanged.
groups.restoreBody: Restore the selected groups to the active list.
groups.deleteBody: Permanently delete archived groups and their owned materials and questions. Independent test copies remain unchanged. This cannot be undone.
groups.legacyMaterial: This historical material uses Markdown. Edit the source and use Preview material to review it.
